interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim overgrown bushes to ensure clear sightlines at driveways and conflict points.

interventions.description: Install concrete curbs to define the roadway edge and manage vehicle access points.

interventions.title: Regular Maintenance

interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk to at least 6 feet and repair cracked sections to improve accessibility.

interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility of pedestrians on the sidewalk and at potential crossing points during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and level the existing sidewalk to provide a safe, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk's material and elevation across the driveway to reinforce pedestrian right-of-way and slow turning traffic.
